name: post-single
query: query($relativePath: String!) { post(relativePath: $relativePath) { id title published date rating hero tags blocks { __typename ... on PostBlocksHero { headline } ... on PostBlocksQuote { text cite } } seo { title description } author { ... on Author { id name scores links { label href } } } body _sys { filename basename relativePath extension collection { name } } } }

name: post-second
query: query($relativePath: String!) { post(relativePath: $relativePath) { title published tags blocks { __typename } author { ... on Author { name } } body } }

name: post-connection
query: { postConnection(sort: "title") { totalCount edges { node { id title tags } } } }

name: post-connection-filter
query: { postConnection(filter: { published: { eq: true } }) { totalCount edges { node { title } } } }

name: author-single
query: query($relativePath: String!) { author(relativePath: $relativePath) { id name scores links { label href } _sys { filename extension } } }

name: author-connection
query: { authorConnection { totalCount edges { node { name scores } } } }
